notes.title: Our first major post-launch update arrives at June 6!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45449805/19234dfa65bf1e98b006d5b2eb70ca92e8659c47.jpg"]

Key Improvements:

1. Performance Optimazation

- Redesigned loading logic to eliminate lag spikes

2. Subtitle Sync Fix

- Fixed timing mismatches in all dialogue sequences

3. Save & Story Progression

-  Resolved bugs blocking branch unlocks and save corruption

4. 2x Playback Optimization

- Smoothed video playback during fast-forward mode

5. Achievement System Patch

- Rebalanced Steam achievement triggers and fixed unlock failures

6. Ending Cinematic Remastered

- Reframed every ending cutscene for narrative consistency

7. Community Reported Fixes

- Addressed player reported issues + QA findings

Thank you for all your support！ We remain committed to further updates – this is just the first step in our flight plan.

With gratitude,

Lost in the Secret Team
